notes.title: Moonflower: Fae's Rest Epilogue DLC
notes.content:
There's many exciting things that The Storytellers Festival brings! 

One of our favourites is something we've been working on for a little while now.

Moonflower is getting a DLC after ending! 

Picking up where the Good Ending left off our lovebirds get to take their romance further and leave behind the drama of the palace. 

New locations, new characters, new story, same great love. 

Stay tuned for more info, and page updates!

Available for Wishlist now!

notes.title: The Art and Lore of Moonflower + Deluxe Bundle
notes.content:
[h1]Moonflower Artbook DLC![/h1]

We have a brand new companion DLC for Moonflower that has just released! 

The Art and Lore of Moonflower is an 84 page art, lore and guide book containing behind the scenes developer commentary, sketches, CGs, BGs, character profiles,  and a tonne of extra world information you didn't even know existed! 

We also delve further into out endings in a step by step guide on how to get out endings, and how our mini game items change the game! 


[h1]Deluxe Edition Bundle[/h1]

Additionally we also have a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/32678/Moonflower_Deluxe_Edition/]new bundle[/url]! 

Get both Moonflower AND the Artbook together for a permanent 10% off discount. 

Already have the game? Complete the set! You only pay for what you don't have.

notes.title: Moonflower: Version 1.2
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

Today we have one final update to Moonflower! 

Moonflower now has two additional sprites in Thane and King Eamon, some script edits and additional sound effects! 

A huge thank you to everyone who's already purchased Moonflower! 

We hope you all enjoy our new faces and hope to see you again in the future with our Lore and Art of Moonflower book and maybe a future DLC? ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Version 1.1.1: MiniGame
notes.content:
A minigame tweak has been released in todays update! 

Based on player feedback we are bringing forward part of our planned update for Moonflower! 

The Minigame has been updated to expand Skylar's instruction as well as add a help guide for the combinations possible, usable ingredients also now have a hover state. 

There are two levels of guidance now, a new help button, which will give a more vague hint if you're struggling but still want to figure it out yourself, and by clicking on the open book a recipe guide will pop up showing all the possible combinations and what they make. 


If you're struggling with endings we also have a guide available on our various platforms or you can download directly here: [url=https://catsonalilypadstudios.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/Moonflower_-Official-Guide.pdf]The Official Moonflower Guide[/url]
